title: feat(console): a 「⋯」 package menu in Studio's top bar; Import on Setup → Packages
body:
Fixes #37139
Fixes #37349

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 在 Studio 打开一个软件包时，有「管理元数据」权限的人会在顶栏左侧应用名（没有应用时是包名）右边看到「⋯」，里面是编辑软件包信息、导出、复制为新软件包、还原到上次发布、收编散落项、在设置中管理；「设置 > 软件包」页头的「新建」旁边多了「导入」。
- 属于 Studio 重构专题：Studio 首页删掉后，这些整包动作在界面上没有入口，这次补回来；顺带删掉 17 条已经没有页面在用、也从没发布过的界面文案。
- 出错时最多是某一项该灰没灰、或该能点却灰了，真正的操作仍由服务器把关，开发视图不变，可以直接撤回。
- 请确认一件事：「复制为新软件包」在只读的安装包上按开发视图的做法灰掉了（服务器本来就拒绝复制只读包），而菜单表里这一项写的是「—」。

## What changes

**One copy of each whole-package action.** `metadata-admin/packageActions.tsx` (new) holds what the development face's detail sheet used to write inline: the page's `/api/v1/packages` request helper, `revertPackage`, `exportPackageFile`, `adoptLooseItems` (+ `adoptedText`), `EditPackageDialog` (moved; still re-exported from `PackagesPage`), the Adopt confirmation (`AdoptLooseItemsDialog`) and the Duplicate form (`DuplicatePackageForm`). `PackageDetailSheet` now imports them; its testids, texts, requests and answers are unchanged (the existing sheet suites pass as they were).

**Studio's 「⋯」 (`studio-design/StudioPackageMenu.tsx`, new).** Drawn by `StudioDesignSurface` into a new `menu` slot of `StudioBackToApp`, right of the app / package name and left of the Studio mark, only when the page has a current package that exists (never `~org` or `~all`) and `useCanAuthorMetadata()` holds. The six items, in the table's order:

| Item | Runs | Greyed when |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Edit package info / 编辑软件包信息 | `EditPackageDialog` on the manifest `/api/v1/packages` lists | read-only package |
| Export / 导出 | `exportPackageFile` | never |
| Duplicate as a new package / 复制为新软件包 | `DuplicatePackageForm` in a dialog → `duplicatePackage` | read-only package (see Acceptance notes) |
| Revert to last publish / 还原到上次发布 | a confirmation, then `revertPackage` | read-only package, or a known pending count of 0 |
| Adopt loose items / 收编散落项 | `AdoptLooseItemsDialog`, then `adoptLooseItems` | read-only package |
| Manage in Setup… / 在设置中管理… | navigates (through the unsaved-work veto) to `setupPackagePath(id)` | never |

A greyed item carries its reason as its `title`. Writability or a pending count Studio has not learned yet greys nothing (the server's gate stays the authority, the same courtesy posture as the rest of Studio). Answers are toasts. After a revert or an adoption the surface bumps its publish nonce (pillars and the pending count re-read) and emits the metadata-refresh pulse; saved package info renames the bar's package name in place. 「发布全部草稿」 is not in the menu.

**Setup → Packages (`PackagesPage.tsx`).** Import now sits in the administration face's header beside New Package, the same input and handler as the development face (also in the folded `⋯` on a narrow header). `?package=ID` on that page opens the package's detail sheet once the list has loaded, then drops the param with a replace (the `?new=package` pattern); an id the list does not name opens nothing. `PACKAGES_PACKAGE_PARAM` and `setupPackagePath` live in `packageSource.ts`. This is a page-local query param, not a route.

**i18n.** Additive: `engine.studio.packageMenu.{trigger,editInfo,duplicate,revert,manageInSetup,noChanges,duplicateTitle,duplicateDescription,revertTitle,revertDescription}` in studio `en` and `zh`. Export and Adopt reuse the development face's own labels.

**Rider #37349 (its own commit, `chore(i18n): remove the studio rows no screen reads`).** Removes 17 rows from studio `en` and `zh`: `engine.studio.menu.typeCount` and `engine.studio.newApp.{title,description,advancedHint,id,help.id,help.name,help.description,help.namespace,help.version,help.type,help.defaultDatasource,help.dependencies,nsDerived,created,exists,failed}`. `ui/scripts/check-i18n-dead-keys.mjs` lists exactly these 17 as confirmed, and a `git grep` outside the catalogue finds no reader. `engine.studio.newApp.nameTaken` and `engine.studio.newApp.appFailed` are still read by `PackageFormDialog` and stay. Released-ness, measured on `npm pack @object-ui/i18n@18.6.0`: its `dist/namespaces/studio/en.js` and `zh.js` carry none of the 17 (only the different `engine.studio.landing.newApp` / `newAppDescription`); control `engine.studio.changes` is present. So this is a plain removal: `Clause-②: no`, no Removed-translation-keys list.

⛔ No server, spec or route change. The development face is not retired.

## Tests

- `studio-design/StudioPackageMenu-37139.test.tsx` (new, 26 cases), real `StudioDesignSurface`, metadata client and `MePermissionsProvider` over a fetch stub:
  - en and zh-CN: the 「⋯」 sits right of the name with the six items in order, labelled; no publish-all item.
  - en and zh-CN: greyed states — writable with changes greys nothing; a read-only installed package greys Edit, Duplicate, Revert, Adopt with the read-only reason; no pending changes greys Revert alone with its reason.
  - en and zh-CN: none on `~org`, none on `~all`, none without `manage_metadata` (with a same-page control that has it).
  - behaviour: Export reads the export door and downloads; Revert's Cancel sends nothing and its confirm sends `POST …/revert`, after which the pending count clears; Adopt confirms then sends `POST …/adopt-orphans` and says 3 moved; Duplicate opens on 「Copy of Sales」 / `ID-copy` and sends the duplicate body; Edit opens the edit dialog on the listed manifest; Manage in Setup… lands on `/apps/setup/component/developer/packages?face=admin&package=ID`.
  - one copy: both surfaces import the six shared names from `packageActions`, and neither spells the revert or adopt request in place.
- `metadata-admin/PackagesPage.installedAppsUpdates-34722.test.tsx` (the admin face's harness): the three assertions that said the admin face has no Import now say it has; new describes pin, in en and zh, Import before New Package in one header group and Import installing the file and re-reading the list (development-face control); and `?package=ID` opening that package's detail (Disable, Delete) and dropping the param, with an unknown id opening nothing.

## Acceptance notes

- **Duplicate is greyed on a read-only package**, though the table's column says 「—」 for it. The server refuses that duplicate (`DUPLICATE_SOURCE_NOT_A_BASE`, `requireDuplicableSource`) and the development face does not offer it there, so 「behave exactly as on the development face」 and the server both point that way. Raised in the report's open questions; flipping it is one line.
- **Revert asks first in the menu; the development face's Revert still runs at once.** The table asks for the confirmation; the dispatch keeps the development face unchanged, so the confirmation is the menu's own (new `revertTitle` / `revertDescription` keys). The request is the shared `revertPackage`.
- **Carried from #37134's report:** a Studio-only author (holds `manage_metadata`, not Setup → Packages' `setup.access` + `manage_platform_settings`) still has no New Package door. Not in this card's menu table, so not built here. Relatedly, such an author's 「Manage in Setup…」 leads to a page Setup refuses them; the table gives that item no greyed state, so it is drawn as specified. Both are in the report's open questions.
- The development face is not retired; per the card, that is asked once this lands.

## Verification

Read first: `studio-design/StudioPackageMenu.tsx` (the greyed-state rules and where each answer goes), then `metadata-admin/packageActions.tsx` (the moved code; diff it against the removed lines of `PackagesPage.tsx`), then the `?package=` effect in `PackagesPage.tsx`.

Two-minute check: from the repo root, `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioPackageMenu-37139.test.tsx`. Expect 26 passed.
